caption: The drawing depicts a single glass container with a lid, rendered in black and white. The container has a goblet-like structure, featuring a broad, rounded bowl that narrows at the base, sitting on a short, thick stem and a wide, flat circular foot. The optional lid fits snugly into the opening at the top and is topped with a round knob. Decorative patterns are visible on the container: the body and lid have etched diamond and crosshatch patterns interspersed with etched starburst or fan motifs. The object is centered in the composition, inside a rectangular border, and shading is used to suggest transparency and reflective qualities consistent with glass. The background is plain, and a signature is present in the lower left corner outside the inner border.
title: Sugar Bowl with Cover
